task: Prevent post-DONE activity logging from recreating removed story worktree directories.
outcome: A user runs story_advance DONE from a story worktree and then sees: "Story B-xxx advanced to DONE", "Worktree ... 已清理", koala doctor --format=json reports "orphanDirs":[], and the removed .worktrees/B-xxx path is absent while the activity heartbeat is recorded under the main repo .koala/activity.jsonl.
facts: story_advance DONE removes the story worktree during the same CLI process that later writes the final activity log.
cli-engine writeLog currently detects a removed root by checking for koala.config.json and falls back through resolveRoot().
resolveMainRootFromWorktreeRoot can derive the main repo root from a linked worktree .git file before cleanup, making the fallback independent of process.cwd() after deletion.
worktree-authority-smoke already drives real story_advance DONE paths and is the right place for an end-to-end regression.
doctor --format=json currently reports worktrees.orphanDirs=[] in this repo, so the story does not need a repair/cleanup migration step.
constraints: Do not weaken DONE gate checks or worktree cleanup safety.
Do not treat runtime activity logs as material story evidence.
Keep the fix scoped to activity log routing after terminal cleanup, not general doctor repair behavior.
